items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: What's the name of that trumpet player that played with Santa at the famous door of a long time?

ctx.x: It's up in your audience. Yeah, Larry, she knows Ernie Irwin, Doc Berenson, and Joel Kessler. I was on some guy, his name was Durr, you know? No, I never know. He named Durr, I said, I used to play Louis Durr. Larry, that's Lawrence. He said, that's my father played trombone.

I mean, Durr, how do you spell it? D-U-R or D-O-E-R? D-U-R or something like that. I don't know anybody. What's the name of that trumpet player that played with Santa at the famous door of a long time? The famous door? Bill Gowdy? Yeah. Oh, yeah. I used to play with Bill Gowdy's daddy. Yeah, well.
